---
title: Build Gradio apps into Quarto pages
description: "quarto-gradio runs embedded Python Gradio apps in the reader's browser from static HTML documents."
---

`quarto-gradio` is a [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) extension for publishing Python [Gradio](https://www.gradio.app/) apps inside HTML pages and [Reveal.js](https://revealjs.com/) presentations. A reader opens the published page, the browser starts Python through [Pyodide](https://pyodide.org/), and the app becomes interactive without a Python application server.

{{< include guide/get-started/_hello-world.qmd >}}

Type a name above to see the app respond. The source that creates this app is the same source shown in the [Quickstart](guide/get-started/).

::: {.callout-important appearance="simple"}
The Gradio team [archived Gradio Lite](https://github.com/gradio-app/gradio-lite){target="_blank"} on September 11, 2025. `quarto-gradio` pins its browser runtime to the final `@gradio/lite` release, `5.45.0`. The runtime receives no upstream fixes. Use trusted app code and pinned Python packages.
:::

## What happens when a page opens

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "quarto-gradio renders app source into HTML, then starts the app in the reader's browser."
%%| fig-alt: "Flow from a Quarto source document through the quarto-gradio filter to rendered HTML, then through Gradio Lite and Pyodide to an interactive Gradio app."
flowchart TD
  build["Build time<br/>Quarto source to filter to HTML"]
  browser["Browser time<br/>Gradio Lite to Pyodide to app"]
  build -->|reader opens page| browser
```

Quarto renders the source document. The browser later downloads the runtime, installs app requirements, executes the Python source in a worker, and mounts the interface. This split lets the generated files deploy to static hosting. It also means first startup needs network access and the Python source must not contain secrets.

Read [How it Works](concepts/how-it-works/) for the complete model or [Runtime and Trust](concepts/runtime/) for version, network, and security boundaries.
